name: Compport
summary: Compport is total compensation software with compensation planning, merit cycles, bonus planning, incentive plans and a pay equity module. Its pages say pricing depends on organization size or product choice, and they route buyers to a demo request. No figures are published.

facts.text: The pay equity page says the product helps teams 'Design, maintain and visualize compensation bands aligned to your pay practices.'
The pay equity page poses the questions 'What is the pay equity gap?' and 'Are my pay recommendations biased?' and says teams can 'Build customized dashboards to track the metrics that matter.'
The compensation planning page lists a Merit Cycles module and a Bonus Planning module, and the Bonus Planning text says bonus schemes can be designed, simulated and launched in the product.
The compensation planning page also lists Sales Incentives and Long Term Incentives as separate plan types.

plans.name: Employee-based pricing
plans.notes: The page says 'Pricing based on your organization's size'. No figure is shown. Buyers use the Book A Demo button to get a quote.

plans.name: Product-based pricing
plans.notes: The page says 'Pricing based on your choice of products.' No figure is shown.

plans.name: Tailored solutions
plans.notes: The page says 'Customized pricing to fit your needs.' No figure is shown.

hiddenCosts: The page shows no prices or currency. Pricing is set by organization size, product choice or a custom quote.
